spellcasting.name: Fog Cloud (1/Day)
headerEntries: The mephit casts {@spell Fog Cloud|SRD52}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: The mephit explodes when it dies. {@actSave con} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the mephit. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Cold damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the mephit remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary shard of ice.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Slashing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Cold damage.

action.name: Frost Breath {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 3d4}) Cold damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.
Ice mephits have bodies made of frigid air and frozen water. They delight in freezing things and dropping ice into peoples' clothes.
